 Recusal
 On April 17, 2023, in the exercise of my official duties as Chairperson of the Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board, and in order to avoid any conflict of interest between my official functions and the private interests of a friend and former colleague, I recused myself from any discussion, decision or delegation of duties with respect to an adjudication process that relates to policy grievances between the Treasury Board and employees of the Canadian Human Rights Commission.
 In the exercise of my official duties as Chairperson of the Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board (Federal), I recused myself on December 22, 2021, from participating in any discussion or decision regarding the nomination of a new member, in order to avoid any appearance of preferential treatment or any opportunity to further the private interest of a friend, Mr. Jacek Janczur.
